environment: Headless egui app with synthetic profile-scoped message.start, message.delta and message.complete events. The test inspects AccessKit to verify the first and second chunks appear before completion, Stop response is present while the turn is pending, final text replaces the stream without duplication, and busy state clears. No authenticated Gateway or native window was used.
notes: Partial evidence: the visible streaming path is exercised, but live Gateway behavior, pinned loading-status semantics, and source-paired acceptance remain unverified.
